title: The cost of useful natural gradient updates
summary: What information is needed to turn a natural-gradient direction into a useful finite update? Under a population Kullback-Leibler (KL) budget, we call a step useful if it is feasible and loses at most a fraction $\varepsilon$ of the best feasible gain along the direction. We construct a four-state exponential family whose laws share their initial gradient, scalar Fisher information and natural gradient, yet two laws have disjoint useful-step sets.
